summary: Reproduced the EAS Node20 dependency scenario in a fresh isolated frontend copy and validated install/unit/typecheck/iOS JS export under Node v20.19.4 + Yarn 1.22.22. All requested checks passed with engine checks active and no package/lockfile drift.

critical_code_review_comments: No regressions found against the historical INSTALL_DEPENDENCIES failure root cause; lockfile pins vitest@4.1.11 and installs cleanly on Node 20.19.4.

Current repo state fixes this by pinning vitest 4.1.11 (confirmed in package.json and yarn.lock), so yarn install --frozen-lockfile --production false succeeds under Node 20.19.4 with engine checks enabled.
